product_overview: OpenBook is a backend API for a mobile e-book reader that lets users browse a public catalog, read EPUB content, and manage a personal reading experience. It also supports social and moderation features such as bookmarks, highlights, ratings, reviews, suggestions, and user reports.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and user account management
Offer a searchable, paginated public book catalog with EPUB/PDF support
Enable in-app reading features through EPUB manifest and resource delivery
Support personal library management, reading progress, and favorites
Allow users to annotate books with bookmarks and highlights
Collect community feedback through ratings and reviews
Provide category management and book-to-category assignment
Support moderation workflows for suggestions and user reports

features.name: Authentication & User Management
features.description: Allows users to register, log in, reset passwords, and manage account/profile information.
user_flows: POST /api/Auth/register with valid email and password -> Receive 200 success message -> POST /api/Auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user profile fields -> GET /api/Usuario/{id} with token -> Receive 200 with UsuarioDto
POST /api/Auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/Usuario/solicitar-recuperacion with a registered email -> Receive recovery token response -> POST /api/Usuario/reset-password with token and new password -> Receive success response
POST /api/Usuario/solicitar-recuperacion with an unknown email -> Receive error response or validation failure
GET /api/Usuario/{id} with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 with user details
PATCH /api/Usuario/{id} with token and partial profile fields -> Receive updated user response
DELETE /api/Usuario/{id} with token -> Receive success response

features.name: Book Catalog
features.description: Provides the public book catalog, search and filtering, book upload, cover upload, category assignment, downloading, and deletion.
user_flows: GET /api/Libro/paged with query, author, category, page, and pageSize -> Receive 200 with paginated catalog results -> GET /api/Libro -> Receive 200 with full public catalog

POST /api/Libro/upload-libro with a valid EPUB or PDF file -> Receive uploaded file reference -> POST /api/Libro with metadata and uploaded file data -> Receive 200 created book, with PDF auto-converted to EPUB when applicable
POST /api/Libro/upload-portada with a valid cover image -> Receive uploaded cover reference -> POST /api/Libro with metadata including cover image -> Receive 200 created book
GET /api/Libro/{id}/descargar with a valid token -> Receive EPUB file download
POST /api/Libro/{id}/categorias with authenticated token and category IDs -> Receive success response assigning categories
GET /api/Libro/{id}/libros for a category identifier -> Receive 200 with related books in that category
GET /api/Libro/paged with invalid pagination values -> Receive 400 validation error
DELETE /api/Libro/{id} for an existing book -> Receive success response
GET /api/Libro/{id}/descargar for a missing book -> Receive 404 or not found response

features.name: EPUB Reader Engine
features.description: Serves EPUB metadata and file resources needed by the mobile reader to render chapters, images, and styles correctly.
user_flows: GET /api/epub/{libroId}/manifest for an existing book -> Receive 200 with title, author, reading order, TOC, and resources -> GET /api/epub/{libroId}/resource for a chapter or asset path -> Receive 200 binary content with the correct MIME type
GET /api/epub/{libroId}/manifest for a non-existent book -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/epub/{libroId}/resource for a missing chapter or asset -> Receive 404 resource not found

features.name: User Library
features.description: Lets authenticated users build a personal library, track progress, and mark favorites for books they are reading.
user_flows: POST /api/UsuarioLibro/{libroId} with a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/UsuarioLibro/biblioteca with the same token -> Receive 200 with the user library sorted by last-read date and date added
PATCH /api/UsuarioLibro/progreso with LibroId, Progreso, and PaginaActual -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/UsuarioLibro/biblioteca -> Receive updated progress values in the library list
PATCH /api/UsuarioLibro/favorito/{libroId} with token -> Receive 200 success -> PATCH /api/UsuarioLibro/favorito/{libroId} again -> Receive 200 and favorite status toggled off
POST /api/UsuarioLibro/{libroId} for a book already in the library -> Receive 400 already in library
DELETE /api/UsuarioLibro/{libroId} with token -> Receive success response -> GET /api/UsuarioLibro/biblioteca -> Receive library list without the removed book

features.name: Bookmarks
features.description: Supports creating and managing page bookmarks for a user within a specific book.
user_flows: POST /api/Marcadores with LibroId and Pagina using a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Marcadores/usuario -> Receive 200 with all user bookmarks
POST /api/Marcadores with missing or invalid page data -> Receive validation error
GET /api/Marcadores/libro/{libroId} with token -> Receive 200 with bookmarks for that book
PUT /api/Marcadores/{id} with owner token and new page number -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Marcadores/usuario -> Receive updated bookmark page
DELETE /api/Marcadores/{id} with owner token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Marcadores/usuario -> Receive bookmark no longer present

features.name: Highlights (Resaltadores)
features.description: Allows users to create, list, edit, and delete text highlights identified by CFI range, href, and color.
user_flows: POST /api/Resaltadores with LibroId, Href, CfiRange, and Color using a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resaltadores/usuario -> Receive 200 with all user highlights
POST /api/Resaltadores with an invalid CFI range or missing fields -> Receive validation error
GET /api/Resaltadores/libro/{libroId} with token -> Receive 200 with highlights for that book
PUT /api/Resaltadores/{id} with owner token and updated CFI range/color -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resaltadores/usuario -> Receive updated highlight values
DELETE /api/Resaltadores/{id} with owner token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resaltadores/usuario -> Highlight is removed

features.name: Ratings (Valoraciones)
features.description: Enables users to rate books from 1 to 5, update or delete their rating, and view aggregate rating lists.
user_flows: POST /api/Valoraciones with LibroId and Puntuacion between 1 and 5 using a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Valoraciones/libro/{libroId} -> Receive 200 with all ratings for the book -> GET /api/Valoraciones/top5 -> Receive 200 with the top 5 books by average rating
POST /api/Valoraciones with a second rating for the same book by the same user -> Receive error response due to unique constraint
POST /api/Valoraciones with Puntuacion outside 1 to 5 -> Receive validation error
PUT /api/Valoraciones/{libroId} with a valid token and new score -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Valoraciones/libro/{libroId} -> Receive updated rating data
DELETE /api/Valoraciones/{libroId} with token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Valoraciones/libro/{libroId} -> User rating is no longer included

features.name: Reviews (Reseñas)
features.description: Lets authenticated users write text reviews for books and manage their own reviews over time.
user_flows: POST /api/Resena with LibroId and review Texto using a valid JWT token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resena/libro/{libroId} -> Receive 200 with reviews ordered by date descending
POST /api/Resena with empty or invalid review text -> Receive validation error
PUT /api/Resena/{id} with owner token and updated text -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resena/libro/{libroId} -> Receive updated review content
DELETE /api/Resena/{id} with owner token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Resena/libro/{libroId} -> Review is removed from the list

features.name: Categories
features.description: Manages book categories and supports category discovery and updates across the catalog.
user_flows: POST /api/Categorias with a category name -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Categorias -> Receive paged list including book counts -> PATCH /api/Categorias/{id} with a new name -> Receive 200 success
GET /api/Categorias/{id} -> Receive 200 with category details and total book count
POST /api/Categorias with duplicate or invalid category data -> Receive validation error
DELETE /api/Categorias/{id} -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Categorias/{id} -> Receive not found or removed category response
PATCH /api/Categorias/{id} with invalid id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: User Suggestions
features.description: Allows authenticated users to submit feedback and enables admins to review or delete suggestions.
user_flows: POST /api/Sugerencia with a valid JWT token and suggestion content -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Sugerencia with admin token -> Receive 200 paged list of suggestions
POST /api/Sugerencia without authentication -> Receive authorization error
GET /api/Sugerencia with non-admin token -> Receive authorization error
DELETE /api/Sugerencia/{id} with admin token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Sugerencia -> Suggestion no longer appears in the list

features.name: User Reports (Denuncias)
features.description: Lets authenticated users report other users and allows admins to manage report records.
user_flows: POST /api/Denuncia with a valid JWT token and a target user -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Denuncia with admin token -> Receive 200 with paged reports
POST /api/Denuncia reporting the current user -> Receive error response because self-reporting is blocked
GET /api/Denuncia with non-admin token -> Receive authorization error
DELETE /api/Denuncia/{id} with admin token -> Receive 200 success -> GET /api/Denuncia -> Report is removed from the list

features.name: PDF to EPUB Conversion
features.description: Automatically converts uploaded PDF books into EPUB format during the book upload workflow.
user_flows: POST /api/Libro/upload-libro with a PDF file -> Receive uploaded file reference -> POST /api/Libro with the uploaded PDF metadata -> Receive 200 created book with EPUB output generated automatically
POST /api/Libro/upload-libro with a non-PDF/non-EPUB file -> Receive validation error or unsupported file response
POST /api/Libro with metadata referencing a missing uploaded file -> Receive error response
